_about: The planet sizes the first run can be asked for (--size small|medium|big|default|all; tools/first-run/first-run.mjs). `args`: the arguments added after `--` on the program's command line (a list), or null when this build cannot be asked for that size. Since GW1c only medium is offered (data/biomes/sizes.json), and it is the one the build starts with; small and big stay null until they are offered again (then: a menu row chooses the size, so steps.json gains the keys for it and the row gets an empty list). A size whose args are null is reported as 'not offered by this build' and nothing is run for it.

default.what: the planet this build starts with

small.waiting: small is hidden until its fixes land: only medium is offered

medium.what: the only size this build offers, and the one it starts with

big.waiting: big is hidden until its fixes land: only medium is offered
